validation_queries.error_message: Missing valid amd-smi xgmi link speed samples for one or more GPU agents!
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_info_agent agent WHERE agent.type = 'GPU' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.agent_id = agent.id AND info.name = 'device_xgmi_link_speed' AND event.value > 0)
